entries.title: Rotation layout correction
changes: Fixed Settings and Pause staying off-center after rotating back to landscape.
Fixed battle panels drifting outside the screen after repeated rotations, including during an active wheel spin.
Includes the portrait battles, AUTO-ROTATE BATTLES setting and mobile first-turn hint from v1.2.4.
The same correction is live in the browser. No account-server update is required.

entries.title: Automatic portrait battles
changes: Rotate your phone or tablet during a match to switch between portrait and the normal landscape board, including wheel battles. Menus remain horizontal.
AUTO-ROTATE BATTLES in Settings lets you disable the feature. The choice is remembered per device.
A mobile-only animated phone beside Settings and Chat introduces rotation until your first turn ends.
Fixed missing landscape controls after starting a match in portrait. The current turn and wheel spin are preserved during rotation.
The same update is available in the mobile browser. No account-server update is required.

entries.title: Cofagrigus EX mist and AI-forfeit rewards
changes: Added soft drifting mist around Cofagrigus EX. The mist follows the figure animation setting.
Fixed Cofagrigus EX being skipped by the figure animation filter.
Forfeiting against an AI opponent no longer grants a chest. Forfeiting against a human opponent still grants the usual chest. The account-server update is deployed.
The same figure effect is included in the Windows/Android patch and browser game.

entries.title: Cofagrigus and Cosmoem fixes
changes: Mummy replaces the live Ability and appears on the card and in Active Effects. Eligible affected Pokemon spread Mummy through battles.
The original Ability returns on leaving the field, evolving, devolving, or another Ability-changing effect. Tagging and status recovery do not cure Mummy.
King Mummy gains +1 MP per other friendly Yamask or Cofagrigus on the field, up to 3 MP. Eligible opponents that MP move over Cofagrigus EX receive Mummy.
Nightmare of The Ancient Mummy applies the same Ability change with its existing animation.
Fixed Cosmoem's Black Core evolution prompt after a Teleport surround.
Ranked AI matches do not change rating above 1600, and AI games do not affect win/loss/draw counters. Historical statistics were corrected without deleting replays or changing historical ratings.
Includes the same released fixes for Windows, Android and the browser game.

entries.title: Figure progression references
changes: Enhancement and Wheel Modification resolve figure references through the shared catalog.
The account-server update archived and reconciled older ID/path progression records while preserving earned progression.
Browser v1.2.1 includes all v1.1.9 and v1.2.0 content and fixes.

entries.title: Cofagrigus gift visibility
changes: Gift requests and acknowledgements report the running patch version instead of the installer version.
Outdated figure catalogs refresh after patch updates. Cofagrigus EX appears in New Figures.

entries.title: Cofagrigus EX and Mega Evolution emblem
changes: Added Cofagrigus EX, King Mummy and its signature Nightmare of The Ancient Mummy Z-Move.
Started the Cofagrigus EX launch gift campaign; the original seven-day reveal window remains in effect.
The Mega Evolution emblem appears during the white-light transition.
Includes the approved Celebi, Mega Sableye, Dark Energy, menu-message and replay fixes.

entries.title: Teams, Ranked Preferences and Battle Fixes
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE v1.1.8
TEAMS, RANKED PREFERENCES AND DATABASE

Added multiple favourite teams, toggled with a standalone star beside each team. Favourite teams stay above other teams on every saved-team screen, while keeping the selected sort order within each group. Account favourites sync between installations; local teams keep their favourites on the device.

Added a saved Ranked bot delay, adjustable before and during matchmaking from 30 seconds to 10 minutes. Default keeps the existing rank-based timings. Duel clocks and human-opponent priority are unchanged.

Added Database → Figure Usage, with My Figures and Global Figures tabs showing portraits, match-appearance counts and percentages across all completed recorded modes. Each starting figure counts once per side per duel; global totals count both sides separately. Earlier recordings are added in the background; records without team data are excluded.
BATTLE FIXES
Mega Gardevoir's Cerebral Embrace now limits the remaining action to Mega Gardevoir's MP move, attack or End Turn. Pokémon switched onto the field finish their entry Abilities before play continues.
Fixed Regigigas receiving Thankfulness's extra MP after other effects had already raised it above MP1. Max Revive can now restore Regigigas from the P.C.

Knock Off now cancels one active Plate effect on its battle opponent in White/Gold damage matchups, including when Knock Off loses. Cancelling the active Mega Evolution Plate also ends that Mega Evolution.
Fixed Override and similar adjacent status effects losing their targets when the opposing move relocates the user.
Shattered Psyche now offers movement after the battle's knockout and relocation effects finish, and only while its user remains on the field.
Playful Punch now pushes along the battle's straight line instead of bending into other lanes, including when its user is knocked out.
Sweet Scent no longer gives its user Wait. An already-adjacent selected Pokémon receives the Wait instead.
Z-Move secondary effects now resolve when losing a White/Gold damage comparison, while respecting legal targets and movement restrictions.
Fixed Hyper Beam and similar forced-turn effects creating an extra skipped turn against the AI.
MAYHEM AND QUESTS
Identity Crisis no longer selects None as a random Ability. Older replays retain their original Ability rolls.
Fixed quest replacement buttons blinking during background quest refreshes.

entries.title: Clocks, Replays and Battle Fixes
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE v1.1.7
ONLINE CLOCKS
Match clocks now synchronize regularly with the host so both players see the same time reference.
A client-side clock reaching zero no longer decides a loss by itself. The host validates timer expiry before ending the duel.
Both clocks remain paused during connection recovery and automatic battle presentation; interactive choices still use the chooser's time.
BATTLE FIXES AND PRESENTATION

Fixed Shed Skin not offering its special-condition recovery at the start of your turn. Accepting it removes the condition, offers evolution when eligible, and ends the turn once; declining keeps your turn.
Fixed Mega Gardevoir retaining attack targets beside its old position after using Cerebral Embrace. Attacks are checked from its current position.
Added a short camera zoom and goal-burst effect when a figure scores. This follows your battle animation setting.
REPLAYS
Added a viewing-side button to switch between Player 1 and Player 2 while paused between actions.
Fixed rapid Previous Turn, Next Turn and Restart clicks causing repeated scene reloads or replay crashes.
Older replay recordings keep their original Shed Skin choice sequence.
TEAMS, CHALLENGE MODE AND MENUS
Saved team creation dates now sync with the account, keeping Newest First ordering consistent across installations.
Fixed returning to an empty Elite Four menu when account synchronization fails. The menu stays usable and pending results remain saved for retry.
Fixed Tower hearts showing stale lives when returning before the result finishes saving. The page refreshes as soon as the save completes.
Tower lives now use clear red and grey hearts plus a numeric life count, including on mobile.
Corrected garbled Pokémon text in update installation and restart messages.

entries.title: Battle and Campaign Fixes
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE v1.1.6
BATTLE FIXES
Frozen Pokémon now keep an all-Miss wheel when effects such as Guardian Sphere or Mega Beedrill would otherwise change their Miss segments.
Ultra Necrozma’s Neuroforce now reverses damage boosts from its battle opponent’s own Ability, while leaving buffs from allied Pokémon intact.
Blue Flare and Bolt Strike respect the battle color rules and do not inflict Burn or Paralysis when defeated by Purple or Blue moves.
Switching between Mega Mewtwo X and Y now uses each form’s saved upgraded wheel, including the shiny forms.
CONTROLS
On the installed desktop game, hold Shift while clicking End Turn to skip the optional remaining-actions confirmation. Required actions and other turn restrictions still apply.
CAMPAIGN AND COMMUNITY
Fixed a server error when saving Elite Four and Champion results that could prevent affected runs from continuing. Existing progress and rewards are preserved.
Added support for Discord channel counters showing online players and players searching for or playing ranked matches.

entries.title: Emergency Zones Fix
changes: Fixed no scrollbar or exit button on zones.

entries.title: Mayhem, Replays, Zones & Chat Improvements
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE — v1.1.4
MAYHEM
Six of a Kind now gives both teams the same rarity, while each team still has six copies of its selected Pokémon.
Clarified Unstable Evolution: C, UC and R Pokémon can evolve into eligible EX Pokémon from another evolution line.
REPLAYS AND ZONES
Added WATCH REPLAY to the end-of-match menu so you can rewatch the match directly after its result is saved.
Renamed ULTRA SPACE to ZONES. Ultra Space and excluded Pokémon now appear in separate visual sections for each player.
Return choices for Ultra Space and excluded Pokémon now show figure images, team slots and their last board positions, making identical figures easier to distinguish.
Zone lists and return choices support scrolling and figure-card previews on mobile.
FIGURES AND CHAT
Added a NEW FIGURES tab to Balance Changes, showing all 12 Challenge Mode reward figures with hover or tap previews.
Moved new reward figures out of the Changes tab into New Figures.
Added separate DUEL and GENERAL chat tabs during online matches, so you can follow the community chat without leaving your duel conversation.
Chat drafts, typing and notifications stay separate between the two tabs. Player mutes and reports remain available.
BROWSER
Balance Changes now loads both tabs' figure cards and images together when opened, instead of loading full figures on each hover.
Lightweight previews are reused while the panel is open and released when it closes.
MUSIC
Renamed Original Duel 4 to Practice Duel Theme.
Renamed Original Duel 5 to Don Roger Theme.

entries.title: Elite Four Sync, Battle Fixes & DuelDB Overlay Support
changes: POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE — v1.1.3
ELITE FOUR PROGRESS
Active Elite Four runs and their locked teams now sync to your account, allowing you to continue the same run on another device or browser.
Existing runs are preserved. Open your current run on its original device while signed in to sync it first.
Interrupted result saves can retry safely without granting the same rewards twice.
BATTLE FIXES
Fixed premature Wait losses when Backtrack, knockouts or follow-up movement such as Jet Kick temporarily blocked an Entry Point. Defeat is now checked after the interaction finishes.
Both duel clocks now pause during disconnect recovery and resynchronization, preventing time from running out while the game blocks input.
Fixed Mega Blaziken incorrectly activating regular Blaziken's Fire Power after a knockout. Flare Blitz keeps its own printed knockout effect.
Fixed Black Kyurem's Freeze Shock and White Kyurem's Ice Burn inflicting status through Purple moves such as Fly.
Groudon's Lava Plume now burns only when Groudon is knocked out by a White or Gold attack. Removed the duplicate burn text.
Red Orb and Blue Orb can now be recycled once their Primal effect is no longer active on the field.
Restored the Mayhem indicator in replays without restarting the recorded conditions or affecting Tower progress.
DESKTOP OVERLAYS
Added overlay support for DuelDB.

entries.title: New Features, Improvements & Fixes
changes: ✨ POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE — v1.1.0
Updates introducing in-game chat, player reporting, Wheel Builds, Tower lives, improved rewards, and numerous gameplay and interface fixes.
💬 IN-GAME CHAT & COMMUNITY
Added chat throughout the hub, menus and online matches.
Lobby chat is also available during single-player duels, including Challenge Mode, Mayhem Tower and AI battles.
Move the chat window by dragging its title and resize it using a mouse or finger.
Click a username to open the player's profile, mute them or report them.
Chat usernames retain a consistent colour throughout the session.
Mentions display a red notification badge, and messages that ping you are highlighted.
Press Enter to complete the first suggested @mention, then Enter again to send.
Opening chat automatically displays the latest messages.
Chat follows new messages while you are at the bottom. Scrolling up pauses this until you return.
Added typing indicators, including your own typing.
Removed the Resize label while keeping resizing available.
Added chat-ban support.
Added counters showing players online and players searching Ranked on the hub, online menu and Ranked search screens.
🚩 PLAYER REPORTING
Report offensive chat, cheating, bad behaviour, glitch abuse and other issues.
Reports require a written explanation.
Match reports include the Match ID and available chat history with usernames.
Reports submitted during a duel are delivered after the match ends to include the full conversation.
Reports from menu chat include the latest 100 messages.
🛠️ WHEEL BUILDS, UPGRADES & TEAMS
Added Wheel Builds for level 10 figures!
Save up to five builds, including Default, using your earned upgrade points for free.
Select builds separately for each team slot and form through a searchable, scrollable list.
Added a dedicated WHEEL BUILDS button at the bottom of Wheel Modification.
Wheel edits update previews immediately and are applied together through Save Changes.
Reset Wheel returns allocated points while preserving figure levels and XP.
Saved wheel changes now appear immediately in teams and new matches.
Fixed upgrades reducing multiple equally sized Miss segments.
Redistribution now requires the initial expansion upgrades first.
Invalid reductions return their redistribution points while preserving levels and valid upgrades.
Fixed Shiny Ditto and Challenge reward figures displaying inconsistent levels, incorrectly refusing upgrades or showing incorrect wheel modifications.
Added sorting by figure level in Team Builder and Collection.
Added reordering of Pokémon and plates within teams.
⚔️ BATTLE RULES, ABILITIES & MOVE EFFECTS
Multiplication and division now resolve before damage buffs and debuffs. Chain Level damage remains part of base damage.
Swift Swim grants +1 MP beside a Water-type Pokémon and +1 MP during rain. These bonuses stack to +2 MP.
Attacks from range 2 or 3 protect the attacker from the defending move's effects while preserving the defender's own protection effects.
Confusion applies only to the initial spin of a spin-again attack, including when confusion shifts a Blue result onto that attack.
Confusion always shifts at least one segment. Its animation also appears when the shift wraps back to the original move.
X-Speed converts every White segment sharing the selected attack's name to Gold for that turn.
Porygon's Trace cannot target Mega Pokémon. Copied abilities retain their other effects, but their form-changing effects are ignored.
Starmie's Analytic now accounts for star bonuses already active from plates and passives.
Fiery Breath spins only the selected eligible Pokémon.
Ponyta, Rapidash and Rhyperior can use a plate before activating their abilities.
Kyogre, Groudon and their Primal forms no longer provide passive buffs while excluded or in Ultra Space.
Red Orb and Blue Orb buffs apply only while the corresponding Primal figure is on the field.
Fixed Backtrack resetting evolutions, Mega Evolutions, forms and plate effects.
Reflect Move allows players to choose eligible jump destinations.
Fixed conflicting knockout effects leaving figures stuck. Exclusion takes priority.
Fixed AI Aura Sphere and other chosen knockout effects sacrificing teammates when an eligible opponent is available, including the AI's goalie.
Duel logs now name the new type when Arceus, Silvally or Type: Null changes type.
Corrected the Konck typo in Swampert's Z-Move description.
🏆 CHALLENGE MODE & REWARDS
Fixed some Challenge Mode AI teams failing to load.
Repeat Challenge reward bundles now have a 5% drop chance across every difficulty, including Gym Leaders, Elite Four members and Champions.
Abandoning an Elite Four run no longer restores first-clear rewards for members already defeated.
New Hard Elite Four runs prohibit Ultra Beasts alongside the existing Mega Evolution restriction. Existing runs retain their previous eligibility.
Limited Celebi to one per team. Existing Elite Four runs can finish with their saved teams.
Fixed overflowing reward displays and scrolling with mouse or touch, including during paused battles.
❤️ MAYHEM TOWER LIVES
Added two lives to Tower runs!
Existing runs also receive two lives.
Losing or leaving a Tower battle costs one life. Losing both ends the run.
Clearing every twentieth floor restores lives to two.
🎁 GUARANTEED RANKED CHESTS
Every completed Ranked match now awards a material chest.
Wins and draws use the full rarity odds.
Losses halve higher-rarity odds, with the remaining chance going to Common.
🎨 INTERFACE & LOADING
Collection now caches figure cards for faster return visits.
Added a Collection loading progress bar.
Account entry waits for figures and inventory to finish loading, preventing temporary level 1 figures or empty inventories.
Fixed mobile figure-viewer dragging rotating incorrectly or zooming instead.
Added separate duel dark mode to dim the board floor independently of menu dark mode. It remains off by default.
Hover over figures in balance updates to preview their cards. On mobile, tap to open a scrollable card and tap outside to close.
Removed bracket markers from balance notes.
Fixed the hub update banner cropping its artwork, title and slogan.
Reduced banner navigation dots and their background to 35% opacity.
Fixed custom-lobby header text overlapping team controls.
Fixed duplicate settings buttons on Wheel Modification.
Moved Veen's credit into Art Design Replacements.
🎵 NEW MUSIC OPTIONS
Added Original Duel 4 and 5, each with its corresponding danger theme.
Random Original Duel music now includes all five tracks.
Added Original Menu 2 and the Original Quest Theme to menu music options.
🌐 ONLINE STABILITY & UPDATER
Continued work on mobile interface and online availability issues.
Reduced database load and improved error handling to address account and Ranked timeouts.
Improved online-room reconnection and player-slot recovery.
Fixed attack-effect texture-processing errors associated with battle freezes.
Added support for smaller updates and downloading missing patches in version order.
Improved update validation and recovery, including a Repair Update option in Settings.

entries.title: A New Era Begins! — The Official Release
changes: 🎉 POKÉMON DUEL REMAKE 1.0.0 — A NEW ERA BEGINS!
The wait is finally over! After months of development, Pokémon Duel Remake is officially leaving the Beta phase!

Our biggest and most ambitious update yet introduces a completely redesigned interface, new Pokémon, stunning animations, expanded challenges, a revamped progression system, and massive balance changes.
Thank you to everyone who helped make this incredible milestone possible. The Beta is over, but our journey is only beginning!
🎨 COMPLETE UI OVERHAUL
Completely redesigned menus with a cleaner, more modern appearance and brighter blue accents.
Improved navigation and layouts throughout the game.
Redesigned Pokémon cards with clearer information and improved readability.
Refreshed inventory interface for easier collection and resource management.
Dark Mode is now the default theme.
Light Mode is available through Settings.
🌟 12 NEW POKÉMON FIGURES
Paras and Parasect join the battle!
Kabutops makes its debut!
Starmie and Mega Starmie are now available!
Buneary, Lopunny, and Mega Lopunny join the collection!
Chatot joins the battlefield!
Porygon makes its debut!
Palkia (Origin Forme) and Dialga (Origin Forme) are now available!
Discover new strategies and expand your collection with these 12 new figures!
✨ NEW FIGURE & BATTLE ANIMATIONS
Added animated visual effects for EX, UX, and NX figures.
Shiny Pokémon now sparkle with special star effects.
Expanded battle animations with more animated attacks and move effects.
Improved the visual presentation of battles to bring back more of the original Pokémon Duel experience.
Animations can be disabled through Settings for players who prefer improved performance.
🏆 CHALLENGE MODE — THE ROAD TO CHAMPION
Challenge the Gym Leaders, Elite Four, and Champions of Kanto and Sinnoh!
Face opponents with unique mechanics and special battle abilities.
Normal Difficulty: Begin your journey and conquer each region.
Hard Difficulty: Face stronger opponents and additional restrictions.
Expert Difficulty: Take on the ultimate challenge designed for experienced players.
Earn badges, overcome legendary challenges, and unlock exclusive rewards!
🗼 MAYHEM TOWER — THE CHAOS CONTINUES
Added two new Mayhems to Mayhem Tower!
Climb the tower and face unpredictable battles with unique rules and anomalies.
Adapt your strategies to randomly generated opponents and changing battle conditions.
Push your limits and see how far you can climb!
💎 NEW FIGURE LEVELING & UPGRADE SYSTEM
Introduced a revamped progression system using Rare Metals and Chain Cubes.
Rare Metals are used to increase figure levels and improve attack wheels.
Chain Cubes increase your Pokémon's chain damage.
Gold is no longer required to level up figures!
Collect upgrade materials to strengthen your favorite Pokémon and customize their wheels.
🎁 ANIMATED CHEST OPENINGS & INVENTORY
Added animated chest openings to make collecting rewards more exciting.
Improved the presentation of upgrade materials and rewards.
Refreshed the inventory interface for easier management of chests, materials, and collectibles.
👤 TRAINER CUSTOMIZATION & AVATAR SHOP
Customize your trainer with new personalization options!
Visit the Avatar Shop to unlock customization options using Gold.
Express your personality and make your trainer stand out from the competition!
⚖️ MASSIVE FIGURE BALANCE UPDATE
Over 70 Pokémon figures have received balance changes!
Updated and reworked Pokémon Abilities.
Adjusted attack effects and battle interactions.
Rebalanced attack damage and wheel segment distributions.
Updated Movement Points (MP) for selected figures.
Adjusted figure rarities.
Discover new team compositions, rethink your strategies, and prepare for a completely refreshed competitive meta!
❤️ THANK YOU FOR AN INCREDIBLE BETA!
Version 1.0.0 marks a major milestone in the history of Pokémon Duel Remake.
Every bug report, suggestion, battle, and encouraging message helped shape the game into what it is today.
This release would not have been possible without the support and passion of our amazing community.
And this is only the beginning! More Pokémon, features, improvements, and surprises are coming in future updates.
THE BETA IS OVER. THE DUEL CONTINUES!
